title: Phone list cards: while selecting, Enter or Space on a focused row "more" button still opens its menu
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oK4fFfnLADcipbEeT

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding owed by the L1 REWORK of PR #36305 (#36044, comment 7074874115). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

On the phone layout of a list (the card view `ObjectGrid` draws below 768 px), once a card is selecting, PR #36305 makes every tap inside a card tick the card instead of opening a link, the lookup chip or the row's 「⋮」 menu. A keyboard still reaches the menu: with focus on a card's 「⋮」 button, Enter or Space opens the row menu, because the Radix trigger opens on keydown, which the tap guard does not cover. Enter on a link inside the card fires a click and ticks the card, as a tap does.

Reachable with a keyboard on a narrow window or a phone with a hardware keyboard. Read from code and noted by the dev in PR #36305's Acceptance notes; not measured on a running page.

## To do

- While the card is selecting, make Enter and Space on the 「⋮」 trigger behave like a tap: tick the card and open no menu. The guard lives on the phone card in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (`buildMobileCardRenderer`).
- Pin it in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/cardSelection-35883.test.tsx`, beside #36044's tap pins.

## Acceptance

- On a phone-width list with a card selecting, focus a card's 「⋮」 and press Enter or Space: the card toggles and no menu opens. After 「×」 ends the selection, the same key opens the menu again.

Reader: area:ux (`domain:ui`), `ui/packages/plugin-grid`.

Dedupe: `keyboard selecting card menu` (objectstack, open) → only #36044 itself.
